# Taxation Administration Act 1953

**PART IVC**
**-**
**TAXATION OBJECTIONS, REVIEWS AND APPEALS**

[View history reference](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=PAC%2F19530001%2FPtIVC&db=HISTFT&stylesheet=HIST "View history reference")

![](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/images/plusbox.gif) View history note

![](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/images/minusbox.gif) Hide history note

History


Pt IVC inserted by No 216 of 1991.

**Division 3**
**-**
**Taxation objections**

[View history reference](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=PAC%2F19530001%2FPtIVC-Div3&db=HISTFT&stylesheet=HIST "View history reference")

**SECTION 14ZYA** **PERSON MAY REQUIRE COMMISSIONER TO MAKE AN OBJECTION DECISION**

[View history reference](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=PAC%2F19530001%2F14ZYA&db=HISTFT&stylesheet=HIST "View history reference")

**14ZYA(1)**

[View history reference](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=PAC%2F19530001%2F14ZYA(1)&db=HISTFT&stylesheet=HIST "View history reference")

This section applies if the taxation objection (other than one under subsection
[155-30(2)](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=%22PAC%2F19530001%2FSch1-155-30(2)%22)
or
359-50(3)
in Schedule
[1](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=%22PAC%2F19530001%2FSch1%22)
) has been lodged with the Commissioner within the required period and the Commissioner has not made an objection decision by whichever is the later of the following times:

**(a)** the end of the period (in this section called the

**_original 60-day period_**
) of 60 days after whichever is the later of the following days:


> **(i)** the day on which the taxation objection is lodged with the Commissioner;

> **(ii)** if the Commissioner decides under section
> [14ZX](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=%22PAC%2F19530001%2F14ZX%22)
>  to agree to a request in relation to the taxation objection
> -
>  the day on which the decision is made;

**(b)** if the Commissioner, by written notice served on the person within the original 60-day period, requires the person to give information relating to the taxation objection
-
the end of the period of 60 days after the Commissioner receives that information.



![](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/images/plusbox.gif) View history note

![](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/images/minusbox.gif) Hide history note

History


S 14ZYA(1) amended by No 39 of 2012, s 3 and Sch 1 item 197, by inserting
"
155-30(2) or
"
, effective 1 July 2012. For application provisions see note under s
[8AAZLG(2)](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=%22PAC%2F19530001%2F8AAZLG(2)%22)
.

S 14ZYA(1) amended by No 161 of 2005, s 3 and Sch 2 item 23, by inserting
"
(other than one under subsection 359-50(3) in Schedule 1)
"
after
"
taxation objection
"
(first occurring), applicable to things done on or after 1 January 2006.

S 14ZYA(1) amended No 179 of 1999, by No 41 of 1998.

**14ZYA(2)**

The person may give the Commissioner a written notice requiring the Commissioner to make an objection decision.


**14ZYA(3)**

If the Commissioner has not made an objection decision by the end of the period of 60 days after being given the notice, then, at the end of that period, the Commissioner is taken to have made a decision under subsection
[14ZY(1)](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?LocID=%22PAC%2F19530001%2F14ZY(1)%22)
to disallow the taxation objection.


![](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/images/plusbox.gif) View history note

![](https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/images/minusbox.gif) Hide history note

History
